tool.name: MAP
tool.description: Metabarcoding Analysis Pipeline: from sequencer output to OTU tables
tool.command:
#import re mkdir -p map_wd map_refs &&
## ---- respect Galaxy's core allocation ---- ## MAP has no "use N cores" flag, only "leave N free". cores_total=\$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 1) ; leave=\$(( cores_total - \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} )) ; if [ "\$leave" -lt 0 ] ; then leave=0 ; fi ;
ln -s '$parameters' parameters.xlsx &&
## ---- reference libraries: MAP looks for <Reference Library>*.fasta ---- #for $ref in $refs #set $ref_name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_', str($ref.element_identifier)) #set $ref_name = re.sub(r'\.(fasta|fas|fa|fna)$', '', $ref_name) + '.fasta' ln -s '$ref' 'map_refs/$ref_name' && #end for
## ---- BIN index: MAP searches <library>*vsearch next to the library ---- ## Linked as <library>.vsearch for every staged library; BIN matching only runs for COI-5P. #if $bin_cond.bin_mode == 'index' ## A zip that Galaxy did not unpack starts with "PK"; a vsearch UDB starts with "FBDU". if [ "\$(head -c 4 '$bin_cond.bin_udb')" != "FBDU" ] ; then echo "ERROR: the BIN index is not a vsearch UDB file. If it is BOLD's vsearch.zip, upload it again with auto-decompress on (the default), or upload the unzipped file." >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi && for lib in map_refs/*.fasta ; do ln -s '$bin_cond.bin_udb' "\${lib%.fasta}.vsearch" || exit 1 ; done && #elif $bin_cond.bin_mode == 'none' ## No BIN matching: an index holding one placeholder sequence that matches nothing, ## so MAP's search finishes at once and every BIN is blank, instead of MAP building one. printf '>no_bin_matching|NA\nACGTTGCATGTCGCATGATGCATGAGAGTTGACGTACCTAGGCTAATCGGATCCATGCAATGCCTAGCTTAGGCATCGATCGTAGCATCAGTCAGTACGATCGTACGGTCA\n' > placeholder.fasta && micromamba run -n map vsearch --makeudb_usearch placeholder.fasta --output placeholder.udb --quiet && for lib in map_refs/*.fasta ; do ln -s "\$(pwd)/placeholder.udb" "\${lib%.fasta}.vsearch" || exit 1 ; done && #end if
## ---- reads ---- #if $mode.type == 'pe' ln -s '$mode.reads_r1' reads_R1_001.fastq.gz && ln -s '$mode.reads_r2' reads_R2_001.fastq.gz && #else #for $i, $r in enumerate($mode.reads) ln -s '$r' 'reads_${i}.fastq.gz' && #end for #end if
micromamba run -n map bash /MAP/SCRIPTS/MAP.sh #if $mode.type == 'pe' --fastq reads_R1_001.fastq.gz reads_R2_001.fastq.gz --pe_reads #if not $mode.ill_chimera_check --no_Ill_chimera_check #end if #else --fastq #for $i, $r in enumerate($mode.reads)# 'reads_${i}.fastq.gz' #end for# #end if --params parameters.xlsx --refs "\$(pwd)/map_refs" --wd "\$(pwd)/map_wd" --cores_to_leave "\$leave" --overwrite --sintax_cutoff '$sintax_cutoff' #if str($advanced.customize) == 'yes' --umi_overlap_min '$advanced.umi_overlap_min' --primer_overlap_min '$advanced.primer_overlap_min' --error_umi1 '$advanced.error_umi1' --error_umi2 '$advanced.error_umi2' --error_primer1 '$advanced.error_primer1' --error_primer2 '$advanced.error_primer2' --min_read_and_primer_length '$advanced.min_read_and_primer_length' --max_read_and_primer_length '$advanced.max_read_and_primer_length' --minqual '$advanced.minqual' --maxee '$advanced.maxee' --Ill_abskew '$advanced.Ill_abskew' --Ill_mindiv '$advanced.Ill_mindiv' --LR_abskew '$advanced.LR_abskew' --LR_mindiv '$advanced.LR_mindiv' --minsize_unoise '$advanced.minsize_unoise' --min_rep_prop '$advanced.min_rep_prop' --high_dens_prop '$advanced.high_dens_prop' --alpha_quantile '$advanced.alpha_quantile' --k_multiplier '$advanced.k_multiplier' --BIN_percent_ID '$advanced.BIN_percent_ID' --BIN_maxaccepts '$advanced.BIN_maxaccepts' --BIN_maxrejects '$advanced.BIN_maxrejects' --BIN_maxhits '$advanced.BIN_maxhits' --sintax_randseed '$advanced.sintax_randseed' #end if < /dev/null &&
## ---- run-level outputs to fixed names ---- cp map_wd/output/Demultiplexing_Results_*.pdf demux_report.pdf && cp map_wd/output/*_readcounts.txt readcounts.txt && cp map_wd/output/Individual_Raw_Fastq_Files.tar.gz raw_fastqs.tar.gz

param.name: parameters
param.label: Parameters spreadsheet (.xlsx)
param.help: The MAP parameters workbook ('UMIs and Primers', 'Bulk Sample Metadata' and 'Dictionary Update' tabs).

param.name: type
param.label: Read type
param.help: Paired-end reads are merged with vsearch before demultiplexing (MAP's --pe_reads).
param.option: Single-end / long reads (e.g., Oxford Nanopore, PacBio)

param.name: reads
param.label: Reads (one or more FASTQ.gz)
param.help: Non-demultiplexed reads. Multiple files are concatenated.

param.name: refs
param.label: Reference libraries (SINTAX-formatted FASTA)
param.help: One file per 'Reference Library' named in the parameters file. MAP matches each name as the START of a file name, so name the dataset accordingly: e.g. Reference Library 'BOLDistilled_COI_' matches a dataset named 'BOLDistilled_COI_Jul2026_SEQUENCES_sintax.fasta'. Spaces and other special characters in dataset names become '_'.

param.name: bin_mode
param.label: BIN matching (COI-5P amplicons of 300 bp or more)
param.help: Assigns BOLD BINs to COI-5P OTUs. Needs a BOLD BIN index; choose 'No BIN matching' for other markers or to skip BINs.
param.option: Build the index from the reference library during the job (small custom libraries only)

param.name: bin_udb
param.label: BOLD BIN index (.udb)
param.help: A vsearch UDB index, e.g. BOLDistilled from BOLD: Upload, then 'Paste/Fetch data' with https://us-sea-1.linodeobjects.com/boldistilled/vsearch.zip (Galaxy unzips it). Your Galaxy may already provide one under Shared Data. BIN taxonomy is taken from the COI reference library above.

param.name: sintax_cutoff
param.label: SINTAX confidence cutoff (--sintax_cutoff)
param.help: Ranks assigned with lower confidence are left blank. Per-rank confidences are reported either way.

param.name: umi_overlap_min
param.label: UMI overlap minimum (--umi_overlap_min)
param.help: Multiplier on UMI length during demultiplexing. 0.75 for UMIs of 12 nt or more, 1.0 for shorter.

param.name: min_rep_prop
param.label: Minimum proportion of replicates with the OTU (--min_rep_prop)

param.name: high_dens_prop
param.label: Minimum proportion of replicates in the high-density area (--high_dens_prop)

param.name: k_multiplier
param.label: Contamination floor multiplier (--k_multiplier)
param.help: Below 1 is more permissive, above 1 stricter.

param.name: BIN_percent_ID
param.label: Minimum identity to keep a BIN match (--BIN_percent_ID)
param.help: COI-5P amplicons of 300 bp or more only.

param.name: sintax_randseed
param.label: SINTAX random seed (--sintax_randseed)
param.help: 0 leaves SINTAX unseeded. A positive number makes taxonomy confidences reproducible between runs; SINTAX then runs on 1 thread, so this step is slower.

collection.name: by_sample
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: results by sample per marker

collection.name: by_replicate
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: results by replicate per marker

has_text.text: the BIN index is not a vsearch UDB file

tool.help:
**MAP — Metabarcoding Analysis Pipeline**
MAP turns raw, non-demultiplexed metabarcoding reads and a parameters spreadsheet into per-sample OTU tables with taxonomy (SINTAX, with per-rank confidence), contaminant filtering against negative controls, and, for COI-5P amplicons of 300 bp or more, BOLD BIN matches. It handles long reads (e.g. Oxford Nanopore) and paired-end short reads (e.g. Illumina), several markers per run, and plates sequenced in reverse orientation.
**Inputs**
* *Parameters spreadsheet (.xlsx)* — the MAP workbook (``UMIs and Primers``, ``Bulk Sample Metadata`` and ``Dictionary Update`` tabs). * *Reads* — non-demultiplexed FASTQ.gz: one or more single-end files, or an R1/R2 pair. * *Reference libraries* — one SINTAX-formatted FASTA per ``Reference Library`` named in the spreadsheet. MAP uses the file whose name **starts with** that Reference Library value, so name your datasets to match (e.g. ``BOLDistilled_COI_`` matches ``BOLDistilled_COI_Jul2026_SEQUENCES_sintax.fasta``). If a BOLDistilled library is named but not supplied, MAP downloads the latest release (~1 GB) during the job, which needs internet access on the Galaxy server. * *BIN matching* — for COI-5P amplicons of 300 bp or more, a BOLD BIN index (vsearch ``.udb``) to assign BOLD BINs, or *No BIN matching* for other markers or to skip BINs (every BIN column is then blank). *Build the index during the job* is only for small custom COI libraries: for BOLDistilled it needs about 6 GB and 10 minutes per job.
**Getting a BIN index.** Your Galaxy may provide one under *Shared Data*. Otherwise, use BOLDistilled from BOLD: open *Upload*, choose *Paste/Fetch data*, and paste ``https://us-sea-1.linodeobjects.com/boldistilled/vsearch.zip``. Galaxy downloads it (about 2 GB) and unzips it to the ~6 GB index; keep auto-decompress on, which is the default. Do this once and reuse the dataset. Searching it needs about 7 GB of memory.
BOLD's index holds only each record's Process ID and BIN, so MAP takes the BIN's taxonomy (the *BIN Kingdom* to *BIN Species* columns) from the COI reference library you supply. The index and the library can come from different BOLDistilled releases; records missing from the library then keep their BIN with blank BIN taxonomy, so methods sections should list both releases.
**Outputs**
* *Demultiplexing report (PDF)* — reads per well, by plate. * *Read counts* — reads kept at each step. * *Demultiplexed reads (tar.gz)* — per-sample reads, e.g. for SRA submission. * Per marker (collections named ``<run>_<marker>_<length>``): the Excel results workbook, the HTML report, results by sample and by replicate (TSV), and OTUs found in negative controls.
